name: Painterly 2.5D
summary: Free Blender 5.0+ EEVEE add-on that turns any scene into a hand-painted 2.5D look in one click: toon shading with brush strokes at light/shadow edges, wobbling outlines on twos, and an oil-paint finish. Six media (oil, gouache, watercolour, crayon, coloured pencil, anime cel), a shuffle control and five lighting presets. Installable by an AI agent via AGENTS.md.

access.notes: Outputs (renders/videos) are yours and need no credit, including commercially. Redistributing or bundling the add-on requires keeping the NOTICE.md attribution to KanaWorks_AI (GPLv3 section 7(b)). Brand/logo not under the GPL.

procedure: Download painterly_25d-1.1.1.zip from the GitHub release (do not unzip it).
In Blender 5.0+: Edit > Preferences > Get Extensions > overflow menu > Install from Disk, then pick the zip.
Open the N-panel Painterly tab and click Make It Painterly, or ask an AI agent to follow AGENTS.md.
Pick a medium and lighting preset, or use Shuffle; press F12 to render. Restore the original materials from the add-on panel.

verdict.why: First-party launch (92 likes, 75 bookmarks). GPL-3.0-or-later and NOTICE.md read (outputs need no credit; redistribution must keep the author line). Release zip 200, valid add-on contents, before/after image viewed.
